desc: The importance of having complete features on your e-commerce website cannot be overlooked. At a minimum, there are three essential elements: a checkout system, payment integration, and shipping integration.
html:
The Importance of a Website and an Efficient Checkout System to Boost Online

Having a website for your business is no longer just a complement—it’s a necessity, especially for brands that want to build credibility and drive sustainable sales growth. A website serves as the central hub for all marketing activities, transactions, and customer service. A high-performing website is one that is equipped with efficient, user-friendly features—one of the most critical being a fast and secure checkout system.

Why Is a Website Important for Online Selling?

A website gives business owners full control over their online store—from design and product information to payment systems and promotions. Unlike social media or marketplaces that are bound by third-party algorithms and rules, a website allows brands to present themselves more professionally and independently.

In other words, a website is your primary digital storefront that customers can access anytime. This creates greater opportunities to reach a wider audience and build long-term customer relationships.

Essential Features for a Sales-Driven Website

To ensure your website effectively supports sales, make sure these key features are in place:

1. Comprehensive Payment System

Ease of payment is a crucial factor in online transactions. Your website should have a payment gateway that supports multiple payment methods such as bank transfers, e-wallets, credit cards, and QRIS. The more options you provide, the lower the chance of cart abandonment.

2. Shipping Integration with 3PL

Fast and transparent delivery processes significantly impact customer satisfaction. A website integrated with shipping systems or a 3PL dashboard allows business owners to track deliveries in real time and manage logistics without switching platforms.

3. Fast and Seamless Checkout System

The checkout stage is often the most critical point in determining whether a visitor completes a purchase. If the process is too long or complicated, customers are likely to abandon their carts.

That’s why implementing a fast checkout system is highly recommended—allowing customers to complete purchases using just their phone number and an OTP verification code, without repeatedly filling out forms. This method is not only more convenient but also enhances transaction security.

title: The Importance of Building a Brand for UMKM
desc: In today’s digital world, success in online selling is no longer just about being the cheapest or the fastest—it’s about being the most trustworthy. And that trust…
html:
In today’s digital world, success in online selling is no longer just about being the cheapest or the fastest—it’s about being the most trustworthy. And that trust comes from one important thing: your brand.

For many UMKM, the word “brand” might sound like something only big companies need. But in reality, branding is just as important for small businesses. In fact, it can be the key differentiator between your product and thousands of others on marketplaces or social media.

A Brand Is More Than Just a Logo

A brand is not just about having a cool logo or attractive packaging. A brand is how people perceive and remember your business.

From how you respond to customer chats, the quality of your shipping, to the tone of your Instagram posts—everything shapes your brand perception.

For example:

  • If your business is known for being friendly and responsive, that’s part of your brand

  • If your packaging is always neat and your delivery is reliable, that’s also your brand

  • If your communication style is consistent and makes customers feel comfortable, your brand becomes even stronger

Why Do UMKM Need to Build a Brand?

  1. To be memorable: In the digital world, customers scroll through hundreds of products. A strong brand helps you stand out and be remembered

  2. To build trust: A good brand gives customers confidence to buy—even if it’s their first time

  3. To compete beyond price: When your brand offers added value (service, story, quality), customers won’t focus on price alone

  4. To scale your business: A solid brand prepares your business for growth—whether in customers, partnerships, or collaborations

Where Should You Start?

Don’t worry—building a brand doesn’t have to be big or complicated. You can start small, as long as you stay consistent. Here are some simple steps:

  1. Define your story: Why did you start this business? What values do you stand for? Your story is what makes your brand unique

  2. Set your communication style: Formal, casual, or energetic? Align it with your target market

  3. Leverage digital channels: Use Instagram, WhatsApp, or marketplaces consistently in a way that reflects your brand

  4. Use tools that make you look professional: Utilize integrated payment and shipping solutions to build customer trust and convenience. One example is FLIK’s Checkout and Shipping system—sign up through the link provided

A brand isn’t just for big companies. For UMKMs, a strong brand can be the key to growing faster in the digital era. Start building your brand today—even from small things. Because when people trust your brand, they won’t just buy once—they’ll come back, and even recommend you to others.

html:
In today’s digital era, having a great product alone is not enough. Selling through social media doesn’t automatically make customers trust you either. What matters more today is this: having your own website.

For many SME owners, you might still be thinking, “Do I really need a website? Isn’t selling on Instagram or marketplaces enough?”

The answer is: it works—but it’s not optimal. A website is not just an add-on. For brands that want to grow, a website is the foundation of your digital presence.

Why Is a Website Important for Your Brand?

1. Website = Your Official Store Online

If social media is like a brochure or a sales channel, then your website is your main store. It’s where customers can truly get to know your brand—your products, services, testimonials, brand story, and how to order and pay.

And unlike a physical store, it never closes. Customers can access it anytime they want.

2. Makes Your Brand Look More Professional & Trustworthy

Try comparing two businesses selling the same product.
One only exists on Instagram, while the other has a well-designed website with its own domain, complete information, and secure payment system.

Customers are more likely to trust the one with a website—because it shows the business is serious and credible.

3. Full Control Is in Your Hands

On marketplaces or social media, you’re essentially “renting” space. Rules can change, algorithms can shift, and your account could even be suspended.

But with your own website? You’re in control—everything from design, pricing, promotions, to customer data.

4. Can Be Integrated with Other Services

Modern websites can be directly integrated with online payment systems, shipping services, and transaction dashboards. This allows you to:

All of this can be done using FLIK Order Form—a solution that helps simplify online selling and attract new customers. Simply create a landing page with an integrated order form.

A website isn’t just for big companies. UMKMs deserve to look professional and build trust too.

With a website, you’re not just selling products—you’re building a strong brand that stands out, earns trust, and is ready to compete in the digital world.
